mcqs.question: In Thalappalam Service Coop. Bank (2013), how was the term “control” understood in relation to public authority status?
options: Control means status as “State” under Article 12
Control means subjecting BCCI to Article 226 review
Control means recommendation that BCCI be brought under the RTI Act
mcqs.explanation: Thalappalam Service Coop. Bank (2013) held that “control” means substantial control. The Article 12 finding belongs to Zee Telefilms v. Union of India, while Article 226 review was recognised in BCCI v. Cricket Association of Bihar.

mcqs.question: What was the principal holding in BCCI v. Cricket Association of Bihar (2016)?
options: The Lodha Committee reforms were upheld, and BCCI was subject to Article 226 review
BCCI was held not to be “State” under Article 12
BCCI was recommended for inclusion under the RTI Act
mcqs.explanation: BCCI v. Cricket Association of Bihar (2016) concerned the Lodha Committee reforms and held that BCCI was subject to Article 226 review. The Article 12 conclusion arose in Zee Telefilms, while the RTI recommendation was made by the Law Commission’s 275th Report.
